description: Source code for the Address class in PhpSpreadsheet library, handling cell address formatting and reference styles.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Provides methods to generate cell addresses in A1 or R1C1 style, considering relativity and sheet names.

methods.name: cell
methods.description: Creates a cell address as text based on row, column, relativity, reference style, and sheet name.

methods.name: sheetName
methods.description: Formats the sheet name, adding quotes if it contains spaces or brackets, and appends '!'

methods.name: formatAsA1
methods.description: Formats the address in A1 style, considering relativity and sheet name.

methods.name: formatAsR1C1
methods.description: Formats the address in R1C1 style, considering relativity and sheet name.
